title: Week 1 welding vocabulary
intro: Save the words that describe your professional background and use them in your introduction.

words.definition: a skilled worker who joins metal using heat or other tools
the job or process of joining metal
the process of making metal structures or products
a place where practical work is done
a detailed technical drawing or plan
a careful check that work meets the required standard
able to be trusted to do work well and consistently
official proof that a person has met a required standard
